# Suroj Dangol

> Suroj Dangol is a full-stack developer based in Lalitpur, Nepal, working with teams on software applications, SaaS products, integrations, and cloud delivery.

This file is a short index of public website pages. Refer to each page for its current details and context. It does not grant rights to reuse content or set enforceable crawler or model-training rules; consult the site's applicable policies and directives for those requirements.

## Services

- [Spring Boot development](https://surojd.com/services/spring-boot-development/): Java backend services, APIs, and existing application work.
- [Java development](https://surojd.com/services/java-development/): Java application development and codebase improvements.
- [SaaS development](https://surojd.com/services/saas-development/): Product discovery, implementation, and ongoing SaaS development.
- [WordPress development](https://surojd.com/services/wordpress-development/): WordPress site development, integrations, and improvements.
- [WordPress plugin development](https://surojd.com/services/plugin-development/): Custom plugin planning and development.
- [Payment gateway integration](https://surojd.com/services/payment-gateway-integration/): Application payment workflows and integrations.
- [AWS consulting](https://surojd.com/services/aws-consulting/): Application deployment, architecture, and operational planning.
- [VPS management](https://surojd.com/services/vps-management/): VPS setup, troubleshooting, migration planning, and maintenance.
